worker_count_doctrine.definition: 1 cleaner working 1 hour = 1 cleaner-hour. If 2 cleaners work 3 hours, that is 6 cleaner-hours, not 3.
worker_count_doctrine.no_ambiguity_rule: Any hourly price in FIXEO must explicitly state PER CLEANER. The word 'heure' alone is insufficient.
worker_count_doctrine.multi_cleaner_transparency: If a job is quoted with 2 cleaners, the client must see this before booking.
worker_count_doctrine.artisan_rule: Artisan is paid per cleaner-hour they actually deliver. Team of 2 is paid for 2 cleaner-hours per hour of work.

anti_double_charge_doctrine.problem: A minimum visit fee MUST NOT be stacked on top of hourly charges for the same hours.
anti_double_charge_doctrine.recommended_architecture: OPTION B — minimum payable = max(NET-001_minimum, NET-002_hourly × cleaner-hours)
anti_double_charge_doctrine.example_correct: 3 cleaner-hours at 60 MAD/ch = 180 MAD. If minimum = 200 MAD, client pays 200 MAD.
anti_double_charge_doctrine.example_correct_2: 4 cleaner-hours at 60 MAD/ch = 240 MAD. Client pays 240 MAD (exceeds minimum).
anti_double_charge_doctrine.example_wrong: Client does NOT pay 200 MAD minimum PLUS 180 MAD hourly for 3h = 380 MAD.

rejected_options.OPTION A: 200 MAD covers exactly 3 cleaner-hours — rejected because this creates artificial hour-bucket confusion with NET-002
rejected_options.OPTION C: Fixed minimum independent of hourly rate — creates incoherence if rates differ

anti_double_charge_doctrine.implementation_note: The minimum visit functions as a floor on the total invoice, not an additional charge.

products_equipment_model.market_finding: Standard residential ménage: products typically CLIENT_SUPPLIED (confirmed O2 Maroc). Professional deep-clean and specialist services: ARTISAN_SUPPLIED.

MODEL_A.label: Client supplies everything
MODEL_A.client_experience: Client must have supplies ready. Risk of wrong products for surface type.
MODEL_A.market_alignment: HIGH — matches Moroccan residential market norm

MODEL_B.label: Cleaner supplies basic products, client supplies equipment
MODEL_B.client_experience: Better — cleaner arrives with correct products. Client still needs vacuum/mop.

MODEL_C.label: Cleaner supplies everything
MODEL_C.market_alignment: LOW for residential standard; HIGH for deep-clean and specialist services
MODEL_C.recommended_for: NET-004 deep-clean, NET-010/011 sofa, NET-013 mattress, NET-030 post-construction

recommended_fixeo_split.NET_001_NET_002_standard: MODEL_A — client supplies. Must be disclosed prominently before booking.
recommended_fixeo_split.NET_004_deep_clean: MODEL_C — provider supplies all. Include ~50 MAD consumables in economics.
recommended_fixeo_split.NET_010_011_013_014_textile: MODEL_C — injection-extraction machine + specialist products always artisan-supplied.

standard_cleaning_scope_contract.label: Contrat de nettoyage standard FIXEO
included: Dépoussiérage des surfaces accessibles (meubles, rebords, prises, interrupteurs)
Aspiration des sols (tapis, moquette, carrelage, parquet)
Nettoyage standard de la salle de bain (lavabo, douche/baignoire, WC, miroir)
Nettoyage standard de la cuisine (surfaces plans de travail, intérieur micro-ondes si accessible, extérieur appareils)
Nettoyage de la table et des chaises
excluded_explicit: Vitres et fenêtres (sauf offre grand nettoyage)
Nettoyage de la terrasse (sauf surfaces balayables)
standard_cleaning_scope_contract.scope_dispute_rule: Any additional scope must be agreed before the intervention. Artisan cannot add charges on-site without client agreement.

deep_clean_scope_contract.label: Contrat grand nettoyage FIXEO
included: Dégraissage cuisine (four intérieur, hotte, plans de travail)
excluded_explicit: Vitres en hauteur (> 2m sans accès direct)
deep_clean_scope_contract.normal_property_limit: Appartement jusqu'à F4 (150m²). Au-delà: devis ou multiple sessions.

post_construction_scope_contract.label: Contrat nettoyage après travaux FIXEO
included: Élimination poussières fines de chantier (sols, surfaces, rebords)
Lavage et nettoyage des sols (carrelage, parquet, marbre)
Nettoyage des vitres standard (traces de peinture légères, colle légère)
Produits et équipements industriels fournis par l'artisan
excluded_explicit: Décapage de peinture dure ou ciment épais
post_construction_scope_contract.complexity_escape: Résidus sévères (ciment épais, grande quantité peinture) → DEVIS_REQUIS. Client doit déclarer le niveau de saleté avant booking.

architecture_analysis.recommended: OPTION B — minimum payable = max(minimum_price, hourly_rate × cleaner-hours). See anti_double_charge_doctrine.
architecture_analysis.interaction_with_NET_002: NET-001 is the floor; NET-002 rate applies from hour 1. If 3h × rate < minimum, client pays minimum.
architecture_analysis.travel_policy: INCLUDED in price — artisan does not invoice separately

NET-001.rationale: 200 MAD is market mid-point. At 20% commission = 135 MAD net / 3h = 45 MAD/ch net — above proposed 40 MAD floor. Below 250 MAD market ceiling. Coherent with 60–65 MAD/ch rate: 3h × 66.7 MAD = 200 MAD.

50.verdict: BELOW_FLOOR at 3ch/20%. Falls below 35 MAD/ch net floor for short jobs. Viable for longer assignments.

55.verdict: MARGINALLY_VIABLE — 35.7 MAD/ch net at 3h just clears 35 MAD floor. Better at 4h+.

60.verdict: VIABLE — comfortably above 40 MAD/ch net floor at all durations. Falls within Casablanca market (60 DH/h Adom.ma average). Recommended.

65.verdict: GOOD — strong economics. Slightly above Casablanca average but defensible for verified professional segment.

70.verdict: PREMIUM — valid but risks price resistance in secondary cities.

NET-002.worker_count_semantics: PER CLEANER. Two cleaners working 3h = 6 cleaner-hours billed = 360 MAD at 60 MAD/ch. Client must see cleaner count before booking.
NET-002.rationale: 60 MAD/cleaner-hour aligns with Adom.ma Casablanca average (60 DH/h). Achieves 40 MAD/ch net at 3h/20% commission. Consistent with minimum visit: 200 MAD ÷ 3h = 66.7 MAD/ch (minimum slightly above standard rate, which is correct for floor economics). Nationally the 60 MAD rate is at the upper end — appropriate for the FIXEO verified-professional segment.
NET-002.market_note: Informal/direct market is 25–45 MAD/h. FIXEO does not compete here. Professional platform segment is 50–80 MAD/h. 60 MAD is the national mid of this segment.
NET-002.property_size_alignment_note: At 60 MAD/ch, pure hourly underprices vs market for F2/F3+ (210 MAD vs market 250–500 MAD). Resolution: minimum visit floor (200 MAD) and realistic duration estimates produce market-aligned totals. 3.5h × 60 MAD = 210 MAD: slightly below market minimum of 250 MAD for F2/F3. Recommend 65 MAD/ch or verify duration estimates upward.

550.verdict: VIABLE but tight market position — below research anchor

600.verdict: GOOD — matches research anchor, strong worker economics, mid-market positioning

650.verdict: STRONG — excellent economics, slightly above anchor, fully justified for professional segment

700.verdict: PREMIUM — upper market range. Client may resist vs direct booking.

OPTION_A_fixed_F2F3_package.description: Single fixed price for standard F2/F3 reference. Other sizes = explicit adjustment.

OPTION_B_size_tiers.description: Studio / F2–F3 / F4–F5 / Villa fixed packages

OPTION_C_hourly_multiplier.description: Deep-clean = standard hourly × 1.5 multiplier for complexity

NET-004.preferred_architecture: OPTION_B — size tiers with F2/F3 = 600 MAD anchor
NET-004.worker_count_semantics: 2 cleaners standard for F2/F3 deep-clean. Artisan pool shared between 2 workers.
NET-004.products_equipment: ARTISAN_SUPPLIED_INCLUDED — professional products and equipment included in price

NET-010.pricing_unit_note: Per sofa — 2-seat configuration regardless of exact dimensions
NET-010.source_convergence: 3 sources converge at 300 MAD (O2: 300, Hany: 250–400 midpoint, Doulle: from 300). HIGH confidence.

250.verdict: VIABLE — but slightly below anchor and market lower bound

300.verdict: RECOMMENDED — market anchor, strong convergence, excellent economics

350.verdict: PREMIUM — upper range, low market resistance risk given all 3 sources

excluded: Taches incrustées sévères (surcharge possible sur accord préalable)

seat_count_architecture.verdict: SEAT COUNT is the correct pricing unit — validated by all 3 sources. 2/3/5+ seats are distinct market-recognized categories.
seat_count_architecture.alternative_per_m2: Not used by Moroccan market for sofas — rejected

NET-011.source_convergence: 2 sources converge: O2 Maroc = 450, Hany = 350–550 (midpoint 450). HIGH confidence.

face_semantics.market_finding: O2 Maroc prices per-face (200 MAD/face, 400 MAD both). Hany.ma prices per mattress (200–300 MAD for single). Doulle from 150 MAD.
face_semantics.consumer_facing_recommendation: Price as FULL MATTRESS CLEANING (both faces) for simplicity and client clarity. Internal economics: 2 × face rate.
face_semantics.rationale: Consumers think of 'cleaning the mattress', not 'cleaning one side'. Per-face pricing creates confusion about what was actually done.
face_semantics.if_one_face_requested: DEFERRED — complexity creates booking ambiguity. If needed, apply 60% of full price.

180.verdict: MARGINAL — 104 MAD net / 40min = acceptable but limited room for error

200.verdict: RECOMMENDED — market anchor, 3 sources, strong economics per time

250.verdict: PREMIUM — upper range, justified for premium positioning

NET-014.face_semantics: Same as NET-013 — both faces as standard consumer-facing unit
NET-014.source_convergence: Hany.ma: 250–350. O2 Maroc: 400 MAD for 2 faces. Midpoint: 280–300. MEDIUM confidence (2 sources).

NET-030.confidence: LOW — 2 sources only. Human must validate against artisan field data.

economic_analysis.verdict_summary: 15 MAD/m² is too low for medium-size projects (60–80m²) at 20% commission. 18–20 MAD/m² is more defensible. Minimum project of 1000 MAD is critical to protect artisan economics on small jobs.

preferred_candidates_for_human_review.rationale: 18 MAD/m² achieves viable economics (40+ MAD/ch net) across most scenarios. 1000 MAD minimum protects artisans on small 40–60m² projects. Within evidence range of 12–25 MAD/m².

NET-030.worker_count_semantics: 2 workers standard. Price is total team price per m² — not per worker.

deferred_services.label: Journée complète
deferred_services.reason: Addressed by NET-002 hourly (8h × 60 MAD = 480 MAD). Separate 'full-day' architecture adds complexity without clear client benefit. If needed, define as 8-cleaner-hour package. Human may reconsider.

deferred_services.label: Avant/après déménagement
deferred_services.reason: LOW confidence. Market is devis-required. Extrapolated anchor insufficient. Needs field artisan data.

deferred_services.label: Canapé angle 5–6 places
deferred_services.reason: MEDIUM confidence. Anchor 700 MAD. Defer to Phase 7B.8.2 to keep pilot manageable.

deferred_services.label: Tapis petit
deferred_services.reason: LOW confidence (1 source). 180 MAD anchor. Defer.

deferred_services.label: Tapis grand m²
deferred_services.reason: MEDIUM confidence. 55 MAD/m². Defer to keep calibration focused.

deferred_services.label: Post-construction forfait
deferred_services.reason: NET-030 per-m² with minimum project handles this. Redundant as separate service code.

routing.HEAVY: Visible soiling beyond normal — artisan must declare before intervention, not after. Handled by scope escape rule or upfront quote.
routing.POST_CONSTRUCTION: Always NET-030 — never merged with standard cleaning
routing.SPECIALIST: Mold, biohazard, sewage, infestation → ROUTE_TO_SPECIALIST. Never within standard nettoyage artisan scope.

complexity_policy.objectivity_rule: Heavy classification must be based on specific observable triggers stated before booking, not artisan discretion on-site.

proposed_net_cleaner_hour_floor.classification: FIXEO_POLICY — not a Moroccan statistical fact
proposed_net_cleaner_hour_floor.rationale: 40 MAD/ch net is achievable at 60 MAD/ch gross with 20% commission over 4+ cleaner-hours. Below 35 MAD/ch net, intervention economics are unviable for artisans supplying their own transport in Moroccan urban context.
proposed_net_cleaner_hour_floor.implication: If FIXEO commission is 20%, minimum rate must be 60–65 MAD/ch to achieve 40 MAD/ch net floor over 3h minimum.

metier_boundary_policy.vitrerie: Remplacement ou réparation de vitre cassée → VITRERIE. Nettoyage des vitres intactes → NETTOYAGE.
metier_boundary_policy.peinture: Repeindre un mur taché → PEINTURE. Nettoyer une tache superficielle → NETTOYAGE si standard scope.
metier_boundary_policy.plomberie: Fuite, humidité structurelle, source d'eau → PLOMBERIE. Nettoyer la salle de bain → NETTOYAGE.
metier_boundary_policy.demenagement: Transport de meubles → DEMENAGEMENT. Nettoyage du logement avant/après → NETTOYAGE.
metier_boundary_policy.jardinage: Végétation, extérieur vert → JARDINAGE. Balcon/terrasse nettoyage → NETTOYAGE si standard.
metier_boundary_policy.specialist_mold: Moisissures > surface superficielle → SPECIALIST. Nettoyage moisissure légère (< 0.1m²) surface uniquement → NETTOYAGE avec disclosure.
metier_boundary_policy.specialist_biohazard: Sang, décomposition, contamination sévère → SPECIALIST. Aucune exception.
metier_boundary_policy.specialist_pest: Infestation active → SPECIALIST PEST CONTROL avant nettoyage.
